entities.summary: Oliver William Taylor was an Australian bantamweight boxer. He won a silver medal at the 1958 British Empire and Commonwealth Games and a bronze at the 1960 Olympics, before turning professional. He is the older brother of Australian National Boxing Hall of Fame inductee Wally Taylor.
